column3: requireAdminRankCeilingForTarget reads the target's (and actor's) roles; a role grant to the target can commit between that check and the credential write. Every interleaving ends in a state a permitted serial order also produces: "reissue, then promote the target" is allowed (the target held nothing the actor lacks when the reissue ran), and it leaves the actor holding the same one-time password for an account that is then promoted. Residual, same as that serial order: the actor can complete the target's first login (change-password) before the target does, bounded by the OTP expiry (security.one_time_password_ttl, 72h default) and visible in the audit trail (user.one_time_password_reissued, then the password change). The external-identity and suspended refusals are re-read on the row lock inside the transaction, so those cannot go stale. Self-classified in REISSUE-1; the coordinator should confirm.
